## Projects
- [AI Incident Clustering](https://github.com/Rishabh775): AI-assisted incident clustering app using Sentence Transformers, HDBSCAN, and Gemini 2.0 Flash for semantic grouping and LLM classification — placed Top 4 of 25 teams at DevOn's innovation programme.
- [Optimus Assistant](https://github.com/Rishabh775/optimus-assistant): Local-first voice AI assistant with hybrid Ollama + cloud routing, faster-whisper STT, edge-tts, a custom openWakeWord wake word, 23 tools (shell, browser, email, calendar, Home Assistant), and persistent Chroma memory — with sandboxed, confirmation-gated execution.
- [Oxyzon](https://next-js-ecommerce-omega.vercel.app/): Full-stack e-commerce platform with product catalog, cart, server-side pagination, user profiles, GitHub OAuth, and a Prisma/MongoDB data-access layer.
- [Loop](https://loop-sepia.vercel.app/): Music streaming and cloud storage app with uploads, playlists, and offline listening; engineered a reusable useAudio hook coordinating playback state and queue transitions.
